test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is a marginal worker as per standard census definition in India?

options.text: A person who works less than 200 days in a year
A person who works less than 150 days in a year
A person who works less than 100 days in a year
A person who works less than 183 days in a year

solution:
The correct answer is __**A person who works less than 183 days in a year**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the** standard census definition in India**, a marginal worker is an individual who works for **less than 183 days or 6 months in a year.**
